licence: unclear: root LICENSE says project resources and code are not permitted unless authorized (lines 5, 8); README.md line 291 says MIT with community asset licence overrides; C# headers (BattleLoader.cs line 5) say all code is MIT

data_fields.name: max_enemies
data_fields.donor_constant: 8 (comment says max 8; Lua inclusive loop yields up to 9)

data_fields.name: enemy_level_from_floor
data_fields.donor_constant: min(floor, MAX_ROLE_LEVEL), level only raised; MAX_ROLE_LEVEL value not read

best_idea: A gauntlet or tower zone can build each encounter from one floor number alone, with roster size, level band, skill rolls and reward all taken from a few per-floor zone fields.
decision_why: Keep the floor-driven roster, level band and per-floor skill rolls, but cap the roster with zone data (8) and keep simultaneous attackers at MAX_ATTACKERS = 3 in the engine; do not copy the inclusive Lua loop (yields 9) or the unbounded re-roll (licence unclear, clean-room only).
acceptance: A server test starts floor 8 of a gauntlet zone and asserts exactly 2 enemies (8/4), each with base level at most 11 (floor + 3), and never more than 3 attacking at once.
